items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Lyn Hogue was very hot property in Philadelphia.

ctx.x: He used to hang around Minton's? ... I think he played tenor. ... Lyn Hogue was very hot property in Philadelphia. He could pack the place when no one else ... His sister played piano, and a friend of mine played guitar that I used to learn a few things. But they dressed as people from India. So that's the gimmick that took it over. They had turbans and things. ...
What was the music scene like in Philadelphia.
